long_biography.plain_text:
Carsten Knauer founded Collectors Wine World after his own wine collection outgrew his cellar. He built central storage in Essen and turned a shared interest among friends into a business. Its collection focused on Bordeaux, and maintaining access to leading estates meant buying their wines through weaker vintages as well as celebrated ones.

With his wife, Sabine, Knauer also founded the Carolinenhof riding centre and its supporting foundation in Essen-Kettwig. The centre brings together riders with and without disabilities. It offers therapeutic riding, inclusive lessons and vaulting, with adapted saddles and a mounting aid that helps wheelchair users get onto a horse.
